name: Crimson Strike
description:
Deals fire damage to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 560 for the first enemy, and 60% less for all remaining enemies.
Can only be executed while under the effect of Crimson Strike Ready.

※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar.
※Crimson Cyclone changes to Crimson Strike when requirements for execution are met.
